title: Search names
description: content/search/names.yaml: names readers search by that the records don't give, such as acronyms and popular names of one law or case (names) and names for a set of them, such as the Marshall Trilogy (groups). Each has a basis: a published source that uses the name for exactly these items. The site search adds them (site/src/lib/server/search-index.ts).

checked.description: When every basis was last checked.

item.description: A source record key, whose page on this site the name finds (/laws/<key> or /cases/<key>), or a path on this site. Never a Tribal court opinion.

names.description: The names, the first shown when a set's name matches.

source.description: The source record, when there is one.

citation.description: The source, as the Indigo Book cites it.

words.description: The source's own words that use the name, copied exactly.
